body:
The area epic for **the patches and kernel configurations** (`patches-and-configs` in `docs/reviews/areas.json`): every `.patch` and every `linux*.conf` in the tree, 1,742 paths and 777,541 lines at the P1 tip `2174265e9c`, all tier `vendor-carried` -- LibreELEC's and ROCKNIX's patches carried by the fork, plus the fork's own few (the H700 kernel patch, mesa, SDL2, shaderc, webkitgtk, woff2, zerotier-one, fex-emu, the theme). Four tables by what applies them: T40 the patches no plan applies (778 rows, 317,908 lines), T41 the kernel patches and configurations the shipped and test images apply (107, 40,474), T42 the other patches the shipped and test images apply (384, 71,387), T43 the patches only unshipped devices apply (432, 328,516). #339's criterion 2 is this area's: one provenance row per patch a shipped or test image applies -- origin, merged upstream or not, the reason we carry it, the version made against, whether it still applies.

**The maintainer's goal, 2026-10-22 (D-WORKFLOW-181, quoted on #339):** *"... look for where packages may need to be updated ..."* and, for patches, *patches by provenance*: a patch is a claim about an upstream version, and the table says which claims still hold.

## The slices, in execution order

| Order | Slice | Issue | Kind | Depth | Paths |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T40 | patches and kernel configurations no plan applies | #687 | table (reachability) | Local | `patches-dead`: area rows with reach `unreached` (778 paths, 317,908 lines: 760 `.patch`, 18 `linux*.conf`) |
| T41 | kernel patches and configurations the shipped and test images apply | #688 | table (package currency) | Local | `patches-shipped-kernel`: `projects/ROCKNIX/devices/**`, `projects/ROCKNIX/packages/linux*/**`, `packages/linux*/**` with reach `shipped` or `test` (107 paths, 40,474 lines) |
| T42 | the other patches the shipped and test images apply | #689 | table (package currency) | Local | `patches-shipped`: the rest of the area with reach `shipped` or `test` (384 paths, 71,387 lines) |
| T43 | patches only unshipped devices apply | #690 | table (reachability) | Local | `patches-unshipped`: reach `unshipped` or `n/a` (432 paths, 328,516 lines) |

The exact membership of each is `tools/renovation-inventory --order` on the P1 tip (`2174265e9c`). Each slice runs under plan § 6b from the brief the coordinator writes before its dispatch; T40's is `docs/reviews/briefs/patches-dead.md`. **T40 is first because it is cheapest and its classes shape the other three** (order § T40: *its removals shrink only those tables*; under D-WORKFLOW-209 it removes nothing and its dispositions say which rows the other tables need not read). Three slices have already handed their patch directories to T40 by name: T23 (the generic packages' 234 rows inside 117 dead units), T24 (the emulators' twelve recipes), and by construction T19 and T27 hold the shipped kernel configurations.

**What makes this area different:** nothing here is the fork's own except a handful of patches, so a row's question is upstream's -- *merged there, superseded there, or still ours to carry* -- and a `git format-patch` header answers most of it unattended (746 of T40's 760 carry `From:`, `Date:` and `Subject:`); a removal is never the lane's (D-WORKFLOW-209: a table records dispositions, the removal of upstream-carried dead code is one class decision for the maintainer); and a patch that *should* apply and does not (a directory name the build never selects) is a product defect, filed as a bug with its code trace, fixed by a packet.

**Interacting subsystems (read-only context for every slice here):** the build engine's patch selection (`scripts/unpack`'s `PATCH_ARCH`, `config/functions`' `get_pkg_directory`; T5, accepted); the generic packages' dispositions (T23, accepted); the emulators' recipes (T24, accepted); the device slices and the kernel recipe (T11, T27, T28, later); `tools/renovation-inventory`'s `selected_patch_dirs` (T10, accepted; #1049's gap does not reach patches).

**Can this be done on the VM?** Yes, and on the host: the tables read the inventory, the patch headers, the build system's selection code and `upstream/next`; no guest, no build, no device. Whether a renamed patch directory applies is a package build's to show -- not these slices', and recorded as an open item for the next image.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `docs/futros/<date>-m6-patches-and-configs.md` exists and the same text is a comment on this issue, its adding commit dated before T40's first audit commit (`git log --format=%cI --diff-filter=A -- <futro>` earlier than the T40 branch's `00-running-log.md`).
- [ ] Each of the four slice issues above is closed completed with `reviewed-at:` and `fixed-at:` set in its body, and `docs/reviews/status.md` lists the four slices as `closed`.
- [ ] `tools/renovation-drift` reports no closed slice of this area with an unreviewed change at the time the last of the four closes (its output pasted here); for these slices the drift check is a count of LibreELEC-merge commits over the rows, not a re-read.
- [ ] Each slice's audit folder `docs/audits/<date>-epic-m6-<slice>/` passes `tools/lint-audit-artifacts` with the renovation face, and each slice's retro exists under `docs/retros/` and is posted on its issue.
- [ ] The four area tables carry their exact 1,701 owned rows (778 + 107 + 384 + 432), with each path once; a boundary table names the other 41 area rows (T11 one configuration, T27 one configuration, T3 21 RetroArch patches, T17 18 RAOfflineProxy patches), bringing total area coverage to 1,742 without duplicating ownership, and every row a shipped or test image applies (T41's 107 and T42's 384) carries origin, upstream status, the reason carried, the version made against and whether it still applies (#339 criterion 2).
- [ ] Every patch a shipped or test image should apply and does not (a directory the build never selects, a hunk that no longer applies) is a `bug` with its code trace, filed by the finding slice and passing `tools/box-check --issue N`; no patch file is changed on a slice's branch (`git diff --stat <dispatch tip> <tip> -- '*.patch' '*.conf'` empty on each).

Refs #339, #346, #641, #644, #687, #688, #689, #690, #670, #671, D-WORKFLOW-209.


### T42 boundary clarification — 2026-11-02

The current source read confirms 1,742 area rows / 777,541 logical inventory lines. The four table slices own 1,701 rows / 758,285 lines; the other four explicit owners own 41 rows / 19,256 lines. The old criterion incorrectly asked the four tables alone to sum to all 1,742. Its corrected population above preserves the canonical selectors. T42 has 384 native patch rows, including four symlinks, plus a separate inherited comparison table of 50 T40 questions across 26 overrides. T41 retains the four H700 U-Boot patch rows and firmware patch; recipes remain T27/T11. T42's MangoHud link does not transfer its T43 referent. T11 owns the GENERIC_X64 configuration (the historical T19 shorthand above is superseded).
title: M6.P2 E339: Area epic: the patches and kernel configurations (T40, T41, T42, T43)
